semiconductor_relevance: High — Advanced Technology Inc. specializes in inspection and measurement systems specifically designed for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Advanced Technology Inc. is a manufacturer of advanced inspection and measurement equipment tailored for the semiconductor, electronics, and solar cell industries. Their primary offerings include automated optical inspection (AOI) systems for wafers, IC substrates, and HDI PCBs, aimed at enhancing factory automation and quality control.
capabilities: IC Substrate AOI/Automated Final Visual Inspection (AFVI)
